responsibility: Implements the gm2 symbol/type declaration stage that maps front-end symbol-table entities onto GCC trees and types. It tracks fully and partially declared symbols, dependency and watch sets, to-do lists for unresolved constants and constructors, default type/constant initialization, procedure nesting and exported-name handling, and numerous dependency walkers for arrays, sets, procedures, record types, alignments, and unbounded types so declarations are only completed when all required subcomponents are known to GCC.
same_name_distinction: This implementation module is the working declaration engine for the interface declared in `M2GCCDeclare.def`: it maintains sets, lists, and walkers for partially resolved symbols and their dependants so GCC trees are created only when prerequisite types and constants are available. The `.def` file only exposes the callable surface of that stage.
